description: Verify that DUT accepts a SYN with seq = SeqMaxVal (0xFFFFFFFF) and emits SYN,ACK with ack_num wrapping to 0 (RFC 793 §3.1 modulo-32 arithmetic)
approach:
[Objective]
The sequence space is modulo 2^32. seq=0xFFFFFFFF + 1 wraps to 0; the SYN,ACK ack_num must reflect that.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT in LISTEN.
2. Tester → DUT: SYN with seq=0xFFFFFFFF.
3. Observation: DUT → Tester: SYN,ACK with ack_num == 0.

[Pass condition]
DUT SYN,ACK ack_num == 0 (wrap).

[Fail condition]
• Fail_wrong_ack_num — ack_num not zero
• Fail_timeout — no SYN,ACK

verdicts.Pass: DUT acked max ISN with ack=0 (wrap) — normal
verdicts.Fail_wrong_ack_num: DUT SYN,ACK ack_num not zero for max ISN
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No DUT SYN,ACK within listen window
